geometry = gpd.points_from_xy(ldn_2021['Longitude'], ldn_2021['Latitude'])
gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(ldn_2021, geometry=geometry, crs="EPSG:4326")
gdf = gdf.to_crs(epsg=3857)

gdf['cluster'] = gdf['cluster'].astype(str)
red_blue_cmap = ListedColormap(['blue', 'red'])

ax = gdf.plot(
    figsize=(10, 10),
    column='cluster',
    cmap=red_blue_cmap,
    legend=True,
    alpha=0.5,
    markersize=1
)

ctx.add_basemap(ax, source=ctx.providers.CartoDB.Positron)
plt.title("2-Means Clustering of London Houses (2021); Red - Higher income")
plt.axis('off')
plt.show()
